snippet.title: Afterworld - Developer Interview - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/futuregamesshow
A developer interview on Afterworld. Afterworld is the newest grand strategy from Paradox; a grand strategy title set in a post-apocalyptic America. Raise a settlement, stand against those who oppose you, or work from the inside to take everything down. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
